title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in… (CVE-2026-71501)
description: A Cross-site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in Apache JSPWiki versions through 2.12.4 due to improper neutralization of input during web page generation. This flaw allows attackers to inject malicious scripts into web pages. The issue is fixed in version 2.12.5, and users are advised to upgrade to this version to remediate the vulnerability.
